QUOTE: "`derive_scope(repo_root)` ... `_declared_index_scope(root)` ... no index_scope section → None (fall through) ... present but unusable → _Rejected ... no declaration → whole_repo_scope(root)" and "The library-level `derive_scope` falls back to the whole repo and logs the rejection."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope is used first, and that an absent, malformed or unusable declaration falls back to indexing the whole repo. It does note that the CLI refuses a rejected declaration instead of widening, but the library-level fall-through is still stated.
